**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Event handler {name} must be a function
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Pass a function, not a string/number/boolean: `onClick={() => go()}`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <button onClick="go()" />;
```

```tsx prefer
declare const go: () => void;
export const A = () => <button onClick={() => go()} />;
```
